OUR DIRECTION & PHILOSOPHY

Safe by physics.
Governed by proof.

Mini Robotics Central is SeedCore’s public proving ground. Beneath the open simulations and maker blueprints sits our fundamental engineering goal: a verifiable trust runtime and operating foundation for physical AI.

THE PHYSICAL PARADIGM SHIFT

Why mini-robotics changes everything.

Industrial robots weigh hundreds of kilograms and swing kilowatt actuators. If an autonomous model errs by an inch, steel frames bend and humans are injured—which is why industrial robots are locked behind hard physical cages. Mini-robotics under 1 kg is inherently safe-by-physics. Low mass, minimal inertia, and compliant joint limits ensure that physical contact is harmless to humans. This enables fearless personal prototyping on any desk.

  • Sub-1kg Payloads
  • Harmless Collisions
  • Personal Desk Safe
  • Rapid Iteration
THE BEHAVIORAL CHALLENGE

Why trust requires cryptographic proof.

Physical safety does not eliminate autonomy risks. As AI agents and vision-language models take real-world actions, they interact with personal workspaces, sensitive objects, and network services. Without a strict trust boundary, runaway planner loops, actuator over-torquing, or privacy breaches can cause damage. Because physical cages are absent, behavioral governance must be mathematical—enforced via capability tokens, local watchdog revocation, and immutable evidence trails.

  • ActionIntent Gateway
  • Scoped Capability Tokens
  • Sub-ms Watchdog Revocation
  • Content-Addressed Audit Log

THE TRUST LIFECYCLE

From high-level intent to verifiable motion.

How SeedCore admits, bounds, and proves physical actions across the slow brain and fast spine.

01 / PROPOSE

Planner / VLM

Proposes a high-level ActionIntent with target coordinates, speed limits, bounding box, and bounded Time-to-Live (TTL).

→
02 / ADMIT

SeedCore Trust Runtime

Validates capability tokens, policy invariants, and safety boundaries. Signs an ephemeral execution lease via the Rust proof kernel.

→
03 / GOVERN

Embedded Fast Spine

Microcontroller executes 200–500 Hz spline interpolation. Local hardware watchdog trips and kills torque within milliseconds if bounds are exceeded.

→
04 / EXPLAIN

Evidence & Forensic Log

Captures correlated sensor telemetry, signed tokens, and observed outcome into tamper-evident receipts for complete post-execution auditability.

A valid token cannot override physical hardware limits or watchdog kill switches. Captured evidence explains what was attempted and measured; it guarantees auditability without relying on opaque cloud black-boxes.

THE OPERATING FOUNDATION

SeedCore multi-layer technology stack.

Every layer is designed for zero unverified dependencies, maximum determinism, and open mathematical verifiability.

C++17 Dynamics Kernel

Zero-Allocation Physics

Analytically derived Lagrange equations of motion ($M(q)\ddot{q} + C(q, \dot{q})\dot{q} + g(q) = \tau$). Zero dynamic memory allocations during simulation ticks ensure deterministic execution across native desktop and WebAssembly.

WebAssembly ABI 1 & ABI 2

Deterministic Browser Studio

Zero-install client-side physics engines compiled with clang/llvm. ABI 1 powers 2D educational planar lessons; ABI 2 drives the 3D kinematic tree studio with full 64-bit precision and memory-mapped state buffers.

TypeScript Schema Contracts

Typed Simulation Contracts

Formal type declarations (sim-contracts.js and sim-contracts.d.ts) defining joint telemetry, state snapshots, control frames, and WebSerial wire protocols with strict input validation.

MuJoCo Native Workbench

Model Ingestion & Verification

Native robotics workbench with pinned Microduck 0.1.0 MJCF package ingestion. Automated SHA-256 integrity verification, 61/14 tensor layout mapping, and cross-simulation sanity validation.

Hardware Abstraction (HAL)

$150 Fast Spine Blueprint

Microcontroller firmware running on ESP32/RP2040 communicating with Feetech/Dynamixel bus servos. High-frequency spline interpolation (200–500 Hz) with hardware watchdog fail-safes.

Rust Verification Kernel

Cryptographic Proofs & Audit

High-assurance proof verifier producing tamper-evident receipts for action intents, telemetry traces, and policy conformance. Powers deterministic forensic replay and accountability.
